1. **Nav** — name/mark, links: Work, About, Contact (or Hire). Optional Resume link as `#` placeholder.
2. **Hero** — headline for founding AI eng, 1–2 sentence pitch, primary CTA (Get in touch / Hire me), secondary (View work). Placeholder name: Lalith Vardhan. 6. **Hire / contact CTA** — email placeholder `hello@example.com`, optional LinkedIn/GitHub `#` links, clear open-to-roles line.
7. **Footer** — minimal.
